title: Input/Output-weighted Hosted API pricing pilot with streaming session minimums and graceband
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Run a targeted experiment to evaluate per-token pricing that weights input vs output tokens differently for streaming and non-streaming usage, introduce a sessionized minimum (per-connection graceband) to reduce bill noise for conversational clients, and measure enterprise contract impact. Rationale: customer feedback and contract questionnaire responses indicate that large conversational workloads complain about variability and perceived unfairness when short inputs produce long outputs and vice versa. We need to quantify revenue and behavioral impacts of asymmetric IO rates plus a small streaming session minimum/graceband that credits early-session overhead and reduces micro-billing churn. This ticket covers experiment design, simulation, telemetry instrumentation, legal/compliance checklist for contract language, and a two-week public beta with opt-in enterprise customers.
acceptance_criteria: Simulation shows expected bill delta distribution across 100k sampled API sessions with at least three workload archetypes (encoder-heavy, decoder-heavy, balanced)
Telemetry definitions added to Console: per-session ingress tokens, egress tokens, stream_duration_ms, session_min_applied boolean, and customer_visible_line_item for minimum credits
Billing prototype implements input-rate and output-rate multipliers and session minimum crediting in sandbox environment and passes regression tests
Legal/Finance approve draft contract language and SQ (security questionnaire) wording describing asymmetric IO and session minimums
Runbook for customer inquiries and FAQ drafted and reviewed by Support and Sales
decisions: Pilot multiplier: input tokens billed at 0.7x baseline, output tokens billed at 1.3x baseline to keep revenue-neutral on balanced workloads per simulation (tunable)
Session minimum (graceband): per-stream connection minimum of 50 effective tokens (credited if session usage < 50), applies only to streaming endpoints for the beta
Graceband iscredit-style: it reduces the first invoice line items rather than creating refundable credits
Beta access limited to opt-in enterprise contracts; default for new customers remains symmetric per-token rates
Expose feature flag 'io_weighted_stream_min' at account level for rollout and rollback

notes: Rollout plan recommends a 30-day beta window for opt-in enterprise accounts, followed by a 60-day observational hold before wider rollout. If telemetry shows >6% net churn or >10% NPS deterioration among beta customers, revert to baseline symmetric pricing and re-evaluate. Consider shipping a per-account override control for enterprises in Dedicated or Private later.
